text:
maria_cs: Hey team — AuroraAI just ran into a throttling issue during their pilot load test. They asked if we can temporarily increase their request rate and add an IP allowlist for their EU-west staging hosts. Theyre onboarding this week and their CSM flagged renewal sensitivity if latency/regressions persist.

kevin_eng: Got it. Do we have the exact peak RPS and burst pattern from the test? quick checks will determine whether this is a rate config or a capacity/cold-cache problem.

aurora_pmo: Peak was ~220 rps sustained for 30s, then back to 40 rps. Sources are two staging subnets in eu-west-1: `18.51.120.0/24` and `18.51.121.0/24`. We need allowlist + a temporary rate bump for the pilot window (today 09:00-12:00 UTC).

kevin_eng: Thanks. Temporary plan: bump their per-minute token allowance and add the CIDRs to the customer's allowlist. I'll also pin them to `redwood-hosted-prod-v2` model variant for consistent perf.

kevin_eng: CLI I'll run (for audit):
```
redwoodctl customers update auroraai --allowlist 18.51.120.0/24,18.51.121.0/24 --rate-limit-per-minute 4000 --model-variant redwood-hosted-prod-v2 --note "temp onboarding bump 1771234567"
```

maria_cs: Who needs to approve the quota bump from a billing/Sales perspective? Aurora is on a pre-paid credit plan. Theyre asking for a short-term increase without changing the contract.

sasha_onboard: I can take point on the enablement side. I'll run the session at 08:30 UTC to make sure their engineers turn on sticky session pins + KV cache hints. That should lower token churn. I'll also capture post-session feedback for renewal playbook.

kevin_eng: For approval: we can do a one-off emergency bump with finance sign-off via Slack thread. @maria_cs can you confirm they accept a pro-rated charge if the bump exceeds credits?

maria_cs: Confirmed — Aurora agreed to cover any overage beyond their credits for the pilot. I'll loop in finance in a sec.

ops-bot: Audit: customer auroraai updated allowlist by kevin_eng at 1771234682. Changes: +2 CIDRs, rate_limit_per_minute from 1200 -> 4000, model_variant pinned.

aurora_pmo: Appreciate the quick turnaround. One ask: can we have the allowlist active only for the staging workspace (not prod)? We plan to run smoke on staging first.

kevin_eng: Yep — scoping to `workspace: auroraai-staging`. I'll add that tag. Running the command now and will post the job id.

kevin_eng: Job 0a9f2c applied, changes live. Monitoring latency now; will revert the temp bump after 12:00 UTC unless they ask to extend.

maria_cs: I'll send summary + billing note to Aurora and mark this in Salesforce as "Onboarding: config completed, pilot window 09:00-12:00 UTC". Noting renewal risk: medium (asked about SLAs). We'll schedule a health check 3 days post-pilot.

aurora_pmo: Sounds good. Thanks all :rocket:

sasha_onboard: Uploading enablement notes + checklist to the shared drive. I'll include the prompt set we used for perf regression checks.

kevin_eng: Latency looks stable at target 180–220ms p50 for the pinned variant. Will keep an eye on token spend.

maria_cs: Great. Closing the immediate loop. If anything spikes, ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
